result.description: Frontend cloud platform for deploying web apps; REST API manages projects, deployments, domains, env vars, DNS, teams.
result.auth_detail: Access tokens (personal/team/project scoped) passed as Bearer header; OAuth2 via Sign in with Vercel apps (bearer access token, 1h) and Integrations (client ID/secret + redirect code exchange).
result.access_detail: Each user creates own access token at vercel.com/account/tokens; no plan requirement stated on the docs. Hobby plan is free. Sign in with Vercel apps are created from team Settings > Apps with no review, and by default any Vercel account can sign in to them, so end users can connect without vendor approval. Only Marketplace/published Integrations need review; not required for the OAuth app path. Docs are silent on plan limits for Sign in with Vercel app creation (absence of evidence). Some teams require 2FA/SAML for scoped tokens.
result.api_notes: Reference has many categories: Deployments, Domains, DNS, Environment, Access Groups, Billing, Drains, Feature Flags, Integrations, Marketplace, Checks, User, Auth tokens, etc. SDK available.
